newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sets specials twice at 4.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sets specials twice at 4.25 pct.

text.p: The Bank of Canada on Monday intervened in the money market with two rounds of special purchase and resale agreements at 4.25 percent, dealers said.
The central bank intervened after the call loan or overnight lending rate traded above the top of the Bank's 3.75-4.25 percent target range, dealers said.
"Money was trading on the tight side of the call loan band. He's (the central bank) just coming in and holding his band in at 4.25 percent," said one dealer.
After the intervention the call loan traded at 4.25 percent, dealers said.
